title: SPECIAL: LA County: Close-Up Episode 263
description: Welcome to County Critters – a show that highlights the extraordinary working animals that are a crucial part of the Los Angeles County workforce. This special episode highlights a few of the critters from the LA County Natural History Museum including Odin the western screech owl, and Willowbrook and Acacia, the terrier mix duo from the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department K-9 therapy unit.
